title_zh: 给架空王国地图中的传说城堡加专门标识

scenario.label_zh: 给架空王国地图中的传说城堡加专门标识
scenario.goal_zh: 区分游戏中确有其地的城镇与未经证实的传说城堡，并约定用虚线和图例标出后者

context_zh: 桌游设计者与地图画师讨论架空中世纪王国地图，所有地点均为虚构。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: The game takes place in a medieval kingdom, but this map makes every castle look equally certain.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: The northern castle is legendary. In the story, people talk about it, but no living character has found it.

sentences.speaker: Zoya
sentences.text: Whereas the southern towns are places the players can actually visit?

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Exactly. I don't want the map to settle the northern mystery before the game starts.

sentences.speaker: Zoya
sentences.text: I'll draw that castle with a dotted outline and add 'Location unconfirmed' to the key.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Perfect. Keep the solid symbols for the known towns.
